question: Who became the first ever woman chief of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Madhabi Puri Buch.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 4, Madhabi Puri Buch, who became the first-ever woman chief of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI).**
 
• **Madhabi Puri Buch** was appointed as a whole-time member of** SEBI in 2017 and was later elevated to the position of Chairperson in 2020.**
 
• She has over two decades of experience in the financial sector and has previously worked with the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and the International Finance Corporation (IFC).
 
• Buch has been instrumental in introducing several reforms in the Indian capital markets, including the introduction of the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) for investments in mutual funds.
 
• Her appointment as the first woman chief of SEBI is a significant milestone in the history of the Indian financial sector and is expected to inspire more women to take up leadership roles in the industry.
